subject: Renewal origination & capacity sprint — Novamed
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@novamed.com>, Tom Anders <t.anders@novamed.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal origination & capacity sprint — Novamed

Hi Sarah & Tom —

Thanks again for the productive end-of-quarter sync. Per our conversation, I wanted to start the formal renewal origination conversation and map out a short sprint to land terms and a staged capacity uplift. High level:

- Goal: renew for another 12 months with a staged capacity increase (initial uplift + predictable ramp) and updated SLOs for peak windows.
- Ask from you: confirm target start date for the uplift, preferred term length (12 vs 24 months), and procurement contact for PO/timing.
- Proposed timeline:
  • This week (Sept 22–29): align stakeholders and finalize QBR window
  • Oct 2–6: internal pricing & SRE confirmation on latency SLAs for new capacity profile
  • Week of Oct 9: QBR + renewal handshake (formalized via DocuSign)

Could you please confirm availability for a QBR in the week of Oct 9–13? We can run a 45–60 minute session (capacity planning, runbook, commercial terms).

I’ve attached a short outline with proposed capacity scenarios to kick off the discussion.

Proposed internal stakeholders we’ll bring: Ben (pricing & seats), Monica (customer success for onboarding), Karthik (platform/ops for migration windows). If there are other internal or Novamed folks who need to be present please flag them.

Next steps:
- Sarah: confirm QBR week and procurement contact
- Novamed: indicate preferred term and high-level throughput target (avg tokens/min or concurrent requests)
- Redwood: we’ll prepare capacity scenarios and a draft term sheet ahead of the QBR

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,

Hannah Schmitt
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
attachments: Novamed_Renewal_Outline_v1.pdf

From: Sarah Li <sarah.li@novamed.com>

Date: Fri, 22 Sep 2028 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal origination & capacity sprint — Novamed

Thanks Hannah —

Oct 9–13 works for us; our preference would be Oct 11 if that slot is open (we have a leadership offsite early that week). A couple items on our side:

- Procurement: procurement@novamed.com (PO timelines: ~3–4 weeks once terms are agreed).
- Security/compliance: can you surface SOC 2 Type II report and data residency guarantees ahead of the QBR? Our info security team will want that before execs sign off.
- Capacity ask: we expect a ~60% uplift in peak processing by Jan, with sustained +25% average usage. We may be open to a 12-month term with a staged uplift (50% initial + ramp).

Please include our engineering leads if you’ll be discussing migration windows — Tom Anders (t.anders@novamed.com) should be on the calendar.

—Sarah
Sarah Li
Head of Product Operations
Novamed Health
